intro: In the town of Brill, a Forsaken tailor named Gretchen Dedmar struggles against the creeping cold of mortality and decay. Fearing that the encroaching mindless state will rob her of the ability to serve Lady Sylvanas, she asks for simple materials to sew herself a warm blanket.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's so cold, now. The Plague of Undeath crawls through my veins like an icy serpent. The Mindless State will be upon me soon. But no doomed destiny will prevent me from serving our Dark Lady. When the call arose I sewed body bags for the fallen soldiers of Sylvanas's mighty army.
Now my hands shake from the chill. If you would bring me five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread I could sew myself a blanket. Help me, friend, so that I can continue to serve the cause.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I appreciate your efforts, friend. May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day....
